verification.scope: Integrity and aggregate consistency; acquisition/correctness/quality completion is separate

scope: Read-only frozen CLI verification of every sealed attempt in its snapshot, including native preflight, screening, whole-block recovery and completed confirmation arms. Active unsealed work is not certified. Exact acquisition source and unchanged 4606-file execution bundle separately reverified after CLI completion. Recording ledger digest is a later observation, not an atomic before/after binding. No final acquisition, source-audit, performance, portability or completion claim.
